description: User registration, onboarding, Cal.com booking, LiveKit sessions, reflections, and dashboard. This is the end-to-end core product loop.
run_mode: Start HITL for items P1-01 through P1-06 (auth foundation). Switch to AFK for P1-07 onward.

items.title: Prisma Schema — Full Data Models
items.description: Create the complete Prisma schema with all models: User, Session, Reflection, Report, Block. Include all enums: SessionStatus, PlanTier, Category, ReportReason, ReportStatus. Add all required indexes. Run prisma migrate dev to generate migration.
steps: Schema file exists at apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
All 5 models defined with correct fields and relations
All 5 enums defined
Indexes exist on: sessions.status, sessions.scheduledAt, sessions.user1Id, sessions.user2Id

prisma generate produces client without errors
npm run typecheck passes in apps/api
items.notes: Reference the Prisma schema in the master build prompt exactly. Do NOT deviate from the field names or types specified.

items.title: Express App Structure — Base Middleware & Error Handling
items.description: Set up the Express application with proper middleware stack: CORS, helmet, cookie-parser, JSON body parser, rate limiter (express-rate-limit), and a global error handler. Create the router structure with domain-grouped route files. Create a structured error class and error response format.

Global error handler catches all errors and returns { error, statusCode }
AppError class exists with statusCode, message, and optional details
Route files exist (empty is fine): auth.routes.ts, users.routes.ts, sessions.routes.ts, matching.routes.ts, notifications.routes.ts, webhooks.routes.ts
All routes mounted under /api prefix
Health check endpoint GET /api/health returns { status: 'ok' }
Rate limiter on /api/auth/* endpoints: 5 req/min

npm run lint passes

items.title: Shared Types Package — DTOs & Zod Schemas

items.title: Auth — Registration Endpoint (Email/Password)
items.description: Implement POST /api/auth/register. Hash password with bcrypt (12 rounds). Create User record. Generate JWT access token (15min) and refresh token (7d). Set tokens in httpOnly cookies. Return user profile (no password hash).
steps: POST /api/auth/register accepts { email, password, displayName, username }
Request validated with Zod RegisterInput schema
Duplicate email returns 409 with clear error message
Duplicate username returns 409 with clear error message
Password hashed with bcrypt, rounds = 12
User created in database with all required defaults
JWT access token (15min expiry) set in httpOnly cookie named 'access_token'
JWT refresh token (7d expiry) set in httpOnly cookie named 'refresh_token'
Response body contains user object WITHOUT passwordHash
Unit test: successful registration creates user and returns tokens
Unit test: duplicate email returns 409
Unit test: weak password validation (min 8 chars)
npm run test passes
npm run typecheck passes

items.title: Auth — Login, Logout, Refresh Token Endpoints
items.description: Implement POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout, and POST /api/auth/refresh. Login validates credentials, issues tokens. Logout clears cookies. Refresh issues new access token from valid refresh token.
steps: POST /api/auth/login accepts { email, password }
Invalid credentials return 401 (generic message — don't reveal which field is wrong)
Successful login sets access_token and refresh_token httpOnly cookies
POST /api/auth/logout clears both token cookies
POST /api/auth/refresh reads refresh_token cookie, validates, issues new access_token
Expired refresh token returns 401
Unit test: successful login
Unit test: wrong password returns 401
Unit test: refresh token rotation works
Unit test: logout clears cookies
npm run test passes

items.title: Auth — JWT Middleware & Protected Routes
items.description: Create an auth middleware that extracts JWT from httpOnly cookie, verifies it, and attaches the user to the request object. Create a requireAuth middleware that returns 401 if not authenticated. Apply to all routes except auth and webhooks.
steps: authMiddleware extracts access_token from cookies, verifies JWT, attaches req.user
req.user contains: id, email, username, planTier, isActive, isBanned
requireAuth middleware returns 401 if req.user is not set
Banned users get 403 with message 'Account suspended'
Inactive users get 403 with message 'Account deactivated'
Middleware applied to all /api/* routes except /api/auth/* and /api/webhooks/*
Unit test: valid token passes through middleware
Unit test: expired token returns 401
Unit test: missing token returns 401
Unit test: banned user returns 403
npm run test passes

items.title: Auth — Google OAuth Flow

items.title: Cal.com User Provisioning on Registration
items.description: When a new user registers, automatically create a Cal.com user account via Cal.com's API. Store calcomUserId and calcomUsername on our User model. Create default event types (25min, 50min, 75min focus sessions) for the Cal.com user.
steps: Service function createCalcomUser(user) calls Cal.com Admin API to create user

calcomUserId and calcomUsername stored on our User record
Three event types created for the Cal.com user: 25min, 50min, 75min

If Cal.com user creation fails, our user is still created (graceful degradation)
Error logged but not thrown to the user
Unit test: Cal.com provisioning called on registration

items.notes: Cal.com API may require admin-level API key. Store as CALCOM_API_KEY env variable. This is the ONE place we call Cal.com API directly — everything else is webhooks.

items.title: Cal.com Webhook — BOOKING_CREATED Handler
items.description: When Cal.com fires BOOKING_CREATED, create a Session record in our database. Look up both users (organizer + attendee) by email. Set session status to CONFIRMED. Generate a unique livekitRoomName (= session.id). Trigger notification to both users.

Organizer looked up by email → user1Id
First attendee looked up by email → user2Id
If attendee email not found in our system, session created with user2Id = null
Session fields: durationMin from payload, scheduledAt from startTime, status = CONFIRMED
calcomBookingId set from payload.uid for idempotency
livekitRoomName = session.id (cuid)
Duplicate calcomBookingId is rejected (idempotency check)
category parsed from payload.metadata.focusCategory if present

items.title: Cal.com Webhook — BOOKING_CANCELLED & BOOKING_RESCHEDULED Handlers
items.description: Handle cancellation and rescheduling webhooks. CANCELLED sets session status to CANCELLED. RESCHEDULED updates scheduledAt and creates audit trail.

If session is already ACTIVE or COMPLETED, do not cancel (return 409)
BOOKING_RESCHEDULED: find session by calcomBookingId, update scheduledAt
If rescheduled session is within 1 hour of original, update in place
